scope.exhaustiveness: bounded formal-word enumeration; geometric filters are necessary-condition filters

placement_enumerator.description: Finite exhaustive enumeration of pole-image placements and contact-imposed parities.

formal_word_solver.description: Every emitted terminal profile is checked, but the audit explores only configured depth/state bounds and may also apply an explicitly reported temporary cycle-unroll cap.

formal_cycle_unroll_cap.description: Independent anti-echo policy. It prunes a branch after repeated returns to the same residual system, reports every hit as truncation, and does not recognize parametric families.

decorated_solution_canonicalization.description: Canonical key for the terminal contour together with both copy mappings, modulo pole exchange, curve/angle renaming, copy permutation, and global mirror. It annotates but does not delete profiles.

point_angle_solver.description: Exact signed angle classes and forced-zero point turns.

total_turn_filter.description: Exact necessary total-turn feasibility test in the symbolic model.

pole_angle_filter.description: Exact necessary simultaneous inequalities at P0 and P1.

translation_holonomy_filter.description: Rejects only formally proved chord-closure contradictions; undecided systems are retained.

forced_point_coincidence.description: Standalone prototype, not integrated into core status.

external_boundary_builder.description: Constructs the shared inner/outer boundary system and exact linear turn constraints as a separate report layer.

joint_translation_z3.description: Z3/NLSAT solves a polynomial relaxation. UNSAT is an exact discard for the encoded necessary conditions; SAT is only a candidate and the complete rigid-tile realization problem is not yet encoded.

interpretation.quadratic: Every initial variable occurs at most twice across all equation sides.
interpretation.search_exhausted: The current transition-system exploration emptied its queue without hitting either configured bound.
interpretation.search_truncated_with_terminals: At least one terminal profile was found, but more terminal profiles may exist beyond the configured bounds.
interpretation.search_truncated_without_terminals: No terminal profile was found, and existence remains unresolved because a configured depth/state bound or the temporary cycle-unroll cap was hit.
interpretation.cycle_unroll_cap: A temporary anti-echo policy prunes a branch after the configured number of returns to the same residual equation system. It is not parametric cycle recognition and every hit is reported as truncation.
interpretation.exhausted_without_terminals: No terminal profile is reachable in the explored transition graph. This is not a general completeness theorem for arbitrary word equations.
interpretation.method_selection: Try a complete quadratic Nielsen-graph solver for quadratic systems before implementing general recompression.

pipeline_sequence: bounded formal word solving with depth/state/cycle-cap truncation diagnostics
optional decorated-solution canonicalization including copy mappings

interpretation.z3_unsat: Exact for the polynomial relaxation and safe for rejection.
interpretation.z3_sat_or_timeout: Not a realizability proof; the profile remains a candidate.
